Any malicious site can make authenticated requests and read the responses → sensitive data exposure / credential theft via the victim's browser. Exploitable.

2. **Mass-assignment** (`src/routes/preferences.js` + `src/utils/object.js`): `mergePreferences(req.user.settings, req.body)` does `_.merge({}, current, input)` with **no allowlist**. `req.body` is fully attacker-controlled and is deep-merged over `req.user.settings`, letting a user overwrite privileged/protected fields (`role`, `isAdmin`, `plan`, `permissions`, nested flags, etc.). - `prototype-pollution` via `_.merge`: lodash 4.17.20's `merge` already sanitizes `__proto__`/`constructor.prototype` (fixed in 4.17.11) — verified not polluting.
